name: Desktop Power Policy
summary: An event-driven root service that applies a Desktop Mode power policy through Lenovo's firmware profile: on battery the 'balanced' gamezone profile, on AC 'performance', with EPP balance_performance, and it re-enables CPU boost/SMT/GPU auto if a Gaming Mode tool left them disabled. It writes nothing while Gaming Mode is active, so Steam or SimpleDeckyTDP keep full control there.
restart: Nothing. The service starts immediately and acts only in Desktop Mode.
